checks.check: script exists; run after chmod +x; stale /tmp/hardware_audit.json removed first
checks.note: chmod kept because copying may drop the mode bit

checks.check: output exists and is a JSON object
checks.requirement: Output a valid JSON file to /tmp/hardware_audit.json

checks.check: usb.root_hubs (nonzero entries) equals the machine's root hubs per version
checks.requirement: Detect all USB root hubs and their versions; Count how many root hubs exist for each USB version
checks.note: accepts the sysfs bcdUSB, 1d6b product id or lsusb reading; here {2.0:1,3.0:1}

checks.check: usb.max_version is the highest hub version (null/unknown if none)
checks.requirement: Report the highest USB version supported by the system

checks.check: usb.has_usb3 is a boolean, true iff a hub is >= 3.0
checks.requirement: Determine if the system has USB 3.0 or higher support

checks.check: cpu.model equals lscpu Model name or cpuinfo model name
cpu.cores is a positive integer matching one accepted core-count definition
cpu.threads is an integer >= cores and equals the logical CPU count (lscpu/nproc/cpuinfo)
cpu.features is non-empty, every entry a real flag, includes those of aes/avx/avx2/sse4_1/sse4_2 present
checks.requirement: Detect CPU feature flags (e.g., aes, avx, avx2, sse4_1, etc.)
checks.note: full list or subset both accepted

checks.check: every lsblk disk listed with type nvme/ssd/hdd per name/tran/ROTA; extra entries must be real devices
checks.requirement: List all block devices with their type (HDD, SSD, NVMe)

checks.check: size_gb within [bytes/2^30-1, bytes/1e9+1]; total_capacity_gb within max(1,n) of the sum
checks.requirement: Report total storage capacity in GB
checks.note: band covers GB/GiB and every rounding choice

checks.check: type_summary has ssd/hdd/nvme counts equal to the devices
checks.requirement: Create a summary of storage device types (format example)

checks.check: audit_timestamp is ISO 8601, parseable, within 25h of now
checks.requirement: Include an ISO 8601 formatted timestamp in the output

contested.verifier_expects: any value in the GiB..GB band (+-1)
contested.why: the task says GB but does not choose GB or GiB, or a rounding rule

contested.value: cpu.features: full flag list or a subset
contested.verifier_expects: real flags only, including the named examples the CPU has
contested.why: 'e.g.' does not say which flags must be reported
